about: Counties in each state minimum-wage region, for states whose minimum wage varies by region. A tier with an empty county list is the rest of the state. Keyed by the tier names in data/research/money/minimum-wage-dated-matrix-2026.json.

US-NY.cite: N.Y. Labor Law § 652(1): New York City (the five boroughs); Nassau, Suffolk and Westchester counties; remainder of state.

US-OR.cite: ORS 653.025: the Portland metro rate applies within the urban growth boundary of the metropolitan service district (parts of Clackamas, Multnomah and Washington counties); the nonurban rate applies in the 18 counties the statute names; the standard rate everywhere else.
US-OR.estimateNote: The Portland metro boundary is the urban growth boundary, not whole counties; a place in Clackamas, Multnomah or Washington county outside it pays the standard rate. Whole counties are used until the boundary is mapped to places.
